y-m-34-03.s.s2.prompt: Kana polynomial P(x) mu x yedegree 4 kana pasi i0 pamakosha akasiyana e x mangani, tinogona kugadzira kuti P(x) i0 kune x yose? Sarudza nhamba diki zvikuru inotibvumira kuigadzira.

y-m-34-03.s.s2.r.c: Ne6 zvakatarwa, asi haisi nhamba diki. Yatotarwa ne5.

y-m-34-07.title: Kana a³+b³+c³=3abc, nhamba mbiri dzakaenzana here?
y-m-34-07.topic: Multiplication formulas: nhamba nhatu dzinofanira kuenzana here mu a³+b³+c³=3abc?
y-m-34-07.goal: Tonga nemienzaniso inopikisa kuti chirevo chekuti 'kana equation ichishanda, nhamba nhatu dzakaenzana' ndechechokwadi kana chenhema, uye uongorore mamiriro ekuwedzera ayo anoita kuti chirevo chive chechokwadi.
y-m-34-07.material:
Kune real numbers a, b, c, mudzidzi akaita chirevo chinotevera.
  Chirevo: Kana a³+b³+c³=3abc, saka a=b=c.
Mudzidzi akatarisa ne a=b=c=2. Sezvo 8+8+8=24=3·8, equation inoshanda. ('3abc' zvinoreva 3 kuwedzera a kuwedzera b kuwedzera c.)
y-m-34-07.prereq.1: Hauna kudikanwa kuyeuka factorization ye a³+b³+c³-3abc, asi unogona kuverenga zvinoreva kana uchiona expression yakapatsanurwa
y-m-34-07.prereq.2: Ma cubes e real numbers nekuverenga nema negative numbers
y-m-34-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvakanyanya nezve chirevo ichi.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mumashoko kuti mudzidzi akatarisa nzira ipi: 'kana equation ichishanda, nhamba nhatu dzakaenzana' kana 'kana nhamba nhatu dzakaenzana, equation inoshanda'.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kakawanda nema integers madiki kuti uone kana pane nyaya apo equation inoshanda asi nhamba nhatu dzisina kuenzana. Isawo ma negative numbers.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.o.a: Ichokwadi. Nokuti takasimbisa kuti chirevo chinoshanda kana a=b=c
y-m-34-07.s.s1.r.a: Chakatariswa ndiko kutungamira kwokuti 'kana nhamba dzatatu dzakaenzana, chirevo chinoshanda'. Chirevo chiri kutaura kutungamira kwakapesana.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.o.b: Ichokwadi. Chirevo chinoramba chakafanana kana a, b, c dzachinjana, saka nhamba dzatatu dzinofanira kuenzana
y-m-34-07.s.s1.r.b: Chirevo chinoramba chakafanana kana mavara akachinjana (symmetry) hazvireve kuti nhamba dzatatu dzinofanira kuenzana.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.o.c: Hachisi chokwadi. Kana nhamba dzisiri dzose dziri pamusoro, chirevo hachishande
y-m-34-07.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakataurwa pasina kuisa chaizvo nyaya dzinosanganisira nhamba dziri negative.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.o.d: Hazvisati zvazikanwa. Tinotsvaga nyaya apo nhamba dzatatu dzakasiyana asi chirevo chinoshanda
y-m-34-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakasarudza nzira yokutsvaga iwe pachako kana paine nyaya dzinoputsa chirevo.
y-m-34-07.s.s1.explain: Chirevo chinoti 'nguva dzose', saka kutarisa kutungamira kumwe (kana nhamba dzatatu dzakaenzana, chirevo chinoshanda) hakukwani, uye unofanira kuyedza kana paine muenzaniso umo chirevo chinoshanda asi nhamba dzatatu hadzienzani. Kana ukayedza, muenzaniso unopikisa se (1, 2, -3) unoonekwa.
y-m-34-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira matriple matatu akasiyana (a, b, c) enhamba chaiyo anosangana nechirevo a³+b³+c³=3abc asi umo a, b, c hazvisi dzose dzakaenzana. (Kushandisa nhamba dzizere diki kunofadza.)
y-m-34-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba dzizere dzishoma diki uye uverenge a³+b³+c³ ne 3abc zvakasiyana uye uzvienzanise. Isa nhamba dziri negativewo.
y-m-34-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana muenzaniso umo chirevo chinoshanda wawanikwa, verenga kukosha kwa a+b+c mumuenzaniso iwoyo uye uienzanise nemimwe mienzaniso.
y-m-34-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba dzatatu dzose dzakaenzana. Kuti ive muenzaniso unopikisa, dzinofanira kusiyana nomumwe nomumwe.
y-m-34-07.s.s2.explain: (1, 2, -3): 1+8-27=-18 ne 3·1·2·(-3)=-18, saka dzakaenzana. Mumienzaniso yawakagadzira, huwandu hwenhamba dzatatu hunogara hwuri 0. Sezvo a³+b³+c³-3abc=(a+b+c)(a²+b²+c²-ab-bc-ca), kana a+b+c=0 chirevo chinoshanda kunyange nhamba dzatatu dzakasiyana.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.prompt: Mamiriro api angawedzerwa kuti chirevo chokuti 'kana chirevo chinoshanda, a=b=c' chive chokwadi? Sarudza mamiriro ose anoita, kana awedzerwa, kuti a=b=c zvirokwazvo.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.hint.0: Muchimiro umo a³+b³+c³-3abc yakanyorwa sechakawanikwa che (a+b+c) nechimwe chinhu, paradzanisa kuti chinhu chega chega chinofanira kuva nokukosha kupi kuti chakawanikwa chive 0.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.hint.1: Pamamiriro ega ega musarudzo, yedza nemienzaniso yawakagadzira pamusoro kana paine muenzaniso umo mamiriro azadziswa uye chirevo chinoshanda.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.o.a: a, b, ne c dzose inhamba dzizere
y-m-34-07.s.s3.r.a: (1, 2, -3) muenzaniso unopikisa une nhamba dzizere dzose uye unosangana nechirevo.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.o.b: a, b, ne c dzose dziri pamusoro
y-m-34-07.s.s3.r.b: Kana dziri pamusoro, huwandu hahugoni kuva 0, saka chimwe chinhu chiri 0 uye nhamba dzatatu dzinova dzakaenzana.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.r.c: Mu (1, 2, -3), abc=-6 asi nhamba dzatatu hadzienzani.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.r.d: Kana huwandu husiri 0, chinhu chasara chinofanira kuva 0, uye wobva wava nhamba dzatatu dzakaenzana.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.o.e: a, b, ne c dzose dziri negative
y-m-34-07.s.s3.r.e: Huwandu hwenhamba dziri negative hahugoni kuva 0 zvakare, saka nechikonzero chimwe chete senyaya dziri pamusoro, nhamba dzatatu dzinova dzakaenzana.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.explain: a³+b³+c³-3abc=(1/2)(a+b+c)·{(a-b)²+(b-c)²+(c-a)²}. Kana a+b+c≠0, wobva kana chirevo chichishanda chinhu chechipiri chinofanira kuva 0, uye wobva wava a=b=c. Kana dzose dziri pamusoro kana dzose dziri negative, huwandu hausi 0, saka izvi zvinoshanda. Mamiriro okuti inhamba dzizere kana abc≠0 haadzivirire (1, 2, -3).
y-m-34-07.s.s3.acc.0: Mamiriro ose mbiri akarurama. Asi zvingava zvakanaka kuonawo kuti pane mamiriro ari pamusoro, okuti huwandu hausi 0.
y-m-34-07.s.s3.acc.1: Wakasarudza mamiriro ari pamusoro zvikuru. Zvaizova zvakanakisa kuonawo kuti mamiriro ari pamusoro kana negative anovimbisawo kuti huwandu hausi 0 uye saka anosvika pamhedziso imwe chete.

y-m-34-05.title: Kana equation yakarurama, inogamuchirwa seiquotient ne remainder here?
y-m-34-05.topic: Polynomial division: mamiriro ekuva quotient ne remainder kunyangwe A=BQ+R ichishanda
y-m-34-05.goal: Tsimbisa iwe pachako kuti pane ma (Q,R) akawanda anoita kuti A=B·Q+R ishande, unzwisise kuti mamiriro e degree ye remainder anodiwa kuti agamuchirwe seiquotient ne remainder, uye uenderere mberi ne division nekugadzirisa mhinduro isingakodzeri mamiriro.
y-m-34-05.material:
Paradzanisa A(x)=x³+2x²+3x+4 ne B(x)=x²+1. Vadzidzi vatatu vakati zvinotevera, uye vose vatatu vakatsimbisa kuti 'A=B·Q+R inoshanda'.
  Jimin: quotient Q=x+2, remainder R=2x+2
  Harin: quotient Q=x+1, remainder R=x²+2x+3
  Doyun: quotient Q=x, remainder R=2x²+2x+4
y-m-34-05.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa identity ye expression nemamiriro ari pamhedzisiro ye division
y-m-34-05.thinking.1: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakawanda uye kuwana kuti uniqueness inobva pa convention
y-m-34-05.thinking.2: Kuenderera kubva pamhinduro isiri iyo kuenda kumhinduro yakarurama
y-m-34-05.prereq.2: Degree ye polynomial (degree ye term yepamusoro)
y-m-34-05.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira mapeya (Q,R) akawanda anoita kuti A=B·Q+R ishande. Isa Q=x+p, R=ux²+vx+w (p, u, v, w ndema integer), uye utsvage mapeya matatu akasiyana nemapeya akapiwa nevadzidzi vatatu pamusoro uye ane makosha e p akasiyana.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora Q=x+p uye uwedzere B·Q. Kana ukabvisa mhedzisiro iyoyo kubva ku A, inofanira kuva R.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja p integer imwe imwe (uchisiya makosha akashandiswa nevadzidzi vatatu), verenga coefficient imwe neimwe ye R, uye ugadzire tafura.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.fail.c1: Ndapota sarudza p, u, v, ne w seema integer.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.ok.c2: Coefficient ye term ye x² inosangana ne A.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Kana B·Q+R yawedzerwa, coefficient ye term ye x² inosiyana ne2 iri mu A.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.ok.c3: Coefficient ye term ye x inosangana ne A.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Kana B·Q+R yawedzerwa, coefficient ye term ye x inosiyana ne3 iri mu A.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Kana B·Q+R yawedzerwa, constant term inosiyana ne4 iri mu A.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.fail.c5: Kana p iri 0, 1 kana 2, ipeya yatopiwa nevadzidzi vatatu. Ndapota tsvaga p yakasiyana.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.explain: B·(x+p)=x³+px²+x+p, saka R=A-B·Q=(2-p)x²+2x+(4-p). p=2 ndiyo mhinduro yaJimin, p=1 ndiyo mhinduro yaHarin, p=0 ndiyo mhinduro yaDoyun, uye pane dzakawanda sezvaunoda, senge p=3 kana p=-1.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.prompt: Kunyangwe pane mapeya (Q,R) akawanda akadai, convention ipi inodiwa kuti titaure nezve 'quotient ne remainder ye division' seimwe?
y-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mapeya akagadzirwa pamusoro padivi pemumwe uye uenzanise kuti chii chinosiyana peya neimwe mu Q ne R.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa convention imwe neimwe iri muzvisarudzo kumapeya ari pamusoro uye uverenge mapeya mangani anosara.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.o.a: Peya ine degree yakaderera yeQ chete ndiyo inofanira kugamuchirwa
y-m-34-05.s.s2.r.a: Ma Q emapeya awakagadzira ose ndeema linear. Convention iyi haisefi peya.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.o.b: Gamuchira mapeya chete apo degree ye R iri pasi pe degree ye B
y-m-34-05.s.s2.r.b: Wakasarudza chibvumirano chekuenzanisa degree ye remainder ne degree ye divisor.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.o.c: Gamuchira mapeya chete apo ma coefficients ose e R ari positive
y-m-34-05.s.s2.r.c: Pa p=0 ne1 zvakare, ma coefficients ose e R ari positive, saka mapeya akawanda anosara. Panzvimbo pezvo, p=2, apo u=0, inosefwa.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.o.d: Gamuchira mapeya chete apo ma coefficients ose e R ari ema integer
y-m-34-05.s.s2.r.d: Mapeya awakagadzira ose ane integer coefficients, saka convention iyi haisefi chinhu.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.explain: Nemutemo wekuti degree ye R inofanira kuva pasi pe degree ye B (2), coefficient ye x² inofanira kuva 0, saka p=2, ndiko kuti Q=x+2, R=2x+2 ndiyo chete inosara. Pasina convention iyi, pane mapeya akawanda sezvaunoda anoita kuti equation ishande. Saka kana tichitaura mhedzisiro ye division, tinotaurawo kuti 'degree ye remainder iri pasi pe degree ye divisor'.

y-m-34-09.topic: Degree inochinja sei pakuwedzera nokuwanza kwemapolynomial
y-m-34-09.goal: Rongedza degree dzose dzinogona kuva nehuwandu hwezvirevo zviviri zve cubic, gadzira mienzaniso iri chirevo chemutsetse chaizvo zvichienderana nemamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti sei degree yechakawanikwa isingaderi, zvakasiyana nehuwandu.
y-m-34-09.material: A ne B zvose zvirevo zve cubic zvine ma coefficients ari nhamba dzizere (zvirevo zvine coefficient yeizwi rinotungamira re x³ risiri 0). Nyaya apo A+B ndi 0 (chirevo chine ma coefficients ose 0) haina degree inotaurwa, saka hatiifungi.

y-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza zvirevo zviviri zve cubic iwe pachako, verenga huwandu, unyore degree yahwo, uye uzviite kakawanda. Chinjawo kukosha kunotorwa nehuwandu hwema coefficients maviri anotungamira.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana paine nyaya dzinoita kuti degree ikwire muhuwandu, uye kuti degree yakakwirira zvikuru haigoni kupfuura ipi.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.a: Muhuwandu, ma degree haawedzerwi. Ma degree anowedzerwa chinhu chinoitika pachakawanikwa.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.b: Kana mazwi anotungamira akawedzerwa akapera uye izwi re x² rikasara, chirevo che quadratic.

y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.d: Muhuwandu, izwi rakakwirira kupfuura degree yakakwirira yezvirevo zviviri harigoni kuoneka idzva.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.e: Kana huwandu hwema coefficients anotungamira husiri 0, chirevo che cubic.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.r.f: Kana mazwi e x³ ne x² akapera uye izwi re x rikasara, chirevo chemutsetse.
y-m-34-09.s.s1.explain: Izwi rinotungamira rehuwandu ndi x³ kana pasi. Kana huwandu hwema coefficients e x³ husiri 0, degree ndi 3; kana huwandu uhwo ari 0 uye izwi re x² rikasara, degree ndi 2; kana izwi re x rikasara, 1; kana chakagadzikana chete chikasara, 0 (semuenzaniso, huwandu hwe x³+1 ne -x³ ndi 1). y-m-34-09.s.s2.prompt: A(x)=2x³-x²+4x+1. Gadzira zvirevo zvitatu zvakasiyana zve cubic B(x)=px³+qx²+rx+s (p, q, r, s inhamba dzizere) zvokuti A+B chive chirevo chemutsetse chaizvo.

y-m-34-01.s.s1.o.a: Haina kusarudzwa. Kana degree ye f isingazivikanwi, quotient haigoni kusarudzwa
y-m-34-01.s.s1.r.a: Remainder inogona kusarudzwa kunyange pasina kuziva quotient. Tanga nekuverenga kuti pane zvisingazivikanwi zvingani muremainder.
y-m-34-01.s.s1.o.b: Haina kusarudzwa. Kukosha kumwe kwe x, sa f(0), kunofanira kuzivikanwa
y-m-34-01.s.s1.r.b: Nhamba yekukosha kunodiwa inosarudzwa nenhamba yezvisingazivikanwi mumutaurire weremainder. Tanga wawana kuti remainder inogona kunyorwa muchimiro chipi.
y-m-34-01.s.s1.o.c: Yakasarudzwa. Remainder i degree 1 kana pasi, saka pane zvisingazivikanwi zviviri nemamiriro maviri
y-m-34-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakaverenga zvisingazivikanwi uchishandisa chirambidzo chedegree yeremainder ukaenzanisa nenhamba yemamiriro anozivikanwa.
y-m-34-01.s.s1.o.d: Yakasarudzwa. Kukosha kuviri kunozivikanwa f(1)=3 ne f(2)=5 ndiyo remainder pachayo
y-m-34-01.s.s1.r.d: 3 ne5 ndiko kukosha pa x=1 ne x=2. Remainder imutaurire we x, saka kukosha uku hakusi remainder pachayo.
y-m-34-01.s.s1.explain: Mu f(x)=(x-1)(x-2)Q(x)+R(x), degree ye R iri pasi pe2, saka unogona kunyora R(x)=ax+b. Pane zvisingazivikanwi zviviri, a ne b, uye kuisa x=1 ne x=2 kunopa maequation maviri akasiyana, a+b=3 ne 2a+b=5, saka a=2 ne b=1 zvakasarudzwa. Kunyange quotient Q isina kusarudzwa, remainder yakasarudzwa.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitaurire miviri yakasiyana yecubic f(x)=x³+px²+qx+r (p, q, r maintegers) inoita zvose f(1)=3 ne f(2)=5.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x=1 mu f(1)=3 ne x=2 mu f(2)=5, uye unyore maequation maviri anofanira kushanda pakati pe p, q, ne r.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kukosha kumwe chete kwe p, wobva waverenga kuti q ne r zvinotevera sei kubva mumaequation maviri.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.ok.c1: p, q, ne r zvose maintegers.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota sarudza p, q, ne r semaintegers.
y-m-34-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana p=0, saka q=-5 ne r=7, saka f(x)=x³-5x+7, uye f(1)=3 ne f(2)=5. Kana p=1, f(x)=x³+x²-8x+9, uye zvakare f(1)=3 ne f(2)=5. Pane maf akawanda anoita mamiriro nenzira iyi.
y-m-34-01.s.s3.prompt: Kuna maf maviri awakangogadzira, wana unyore remainder kana imwe neimwe yagoverwa ne (x-1)(x-2). Tsanangurawo kana maremainders akafanana kana akasiyana kunyange maf akasiyana, uye nei.
y-m-34-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora f(x)=(x-1)(x-2)Q(x)+ax+b, isa x=1 ne x=2, uye unyore maequation ari mu a ne b.

y-m-34-01.s.s3.model.1: x³-5x+7 ine quotient x+3 neremainder 2x+1, uye x³+x²-8x+9 ine quotient x+4 neremainder 2x+1. Maquotients akasiyana asi maremainders akafanana nokuti ose maviri anoita mamiriro akafanana f(1)=3 ne f(2)=5.

y-m-34-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mukugadzirisa uku wakaenda zvisirizvo.

y-m-34-02.s.s1.line.0: Tsvaga makandidate efactor pakati pemadivisors echikamu chakagara 6, ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6.
y-m-34-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 wakaenda zvisirizvo. Kuverenga f(3)=0 kwakarurama, asi kana x inoita kukosha 0 i3, factor i x-3, kwete x+3 (x inoita x-3=0 i3). Saka mugumisiro wemutsara wechi5 hauna kururamawo. Chaizvo, kuwedzera (x-1)(x+3)(x+2) kunopa x³+4x²+x-6. Kuverenga kwemitsara 1, 2, ne4 kwose kwakarurama. y-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.0: Pakuongorora kwega kwega, verenga kukosha kwe f(x) nekwe (x-1)(x+3)(x+2) uye uvaenzanise.

y-m-34-02.s.s2.o.a: Isa x=-2 mumativi ose maviri uye uenzanise
y-m-34-02.s.s2.r.a: x=-2 kukosha kwakatosimbiswa nekugadzirisa kuti kukosha kwe f i0. Pakukosha uku mativi ose maviri i0, saka kusaenderana hakuoneki.
y-m-34-02.s.s2.o.b: Isa x=3 mumativi ose maviri uye uenzanise
y-m-34-02.s.s2.r.b: Pa x=3, f i0 asi (x-1)(x+3)(x+2) i60. Uku kuongorora kwakawana nzvimbo umo kukosha kwemativi maviri kwakasiyana.
y-m-34-02.s.s2.r.c: Mativi ose maviri ane 1 secoefficient ye x³, saka akafanana. Uku kuongorora kunopfuurwa nemhinduro yakarurama neisina kururama.
y-m-34-02.s.s2.o.d: Isa x=1 mumativi ose maviri uye uenzanise
y-m-34-02.s.s2.r.d: x=1 kukosha kwakatoshandiswa kusarudza factor, saka mativi ose maviri i0. Kupfuura hakuvimbisi kuti zvakarurama.

y-m-34-02.s.s2.r.e: Pa x=0, f i6 asi (x-1)(x+3)(x+2) i-6. Uku kuongorora kunoratidza kuti chiratidzo chechikamu chakagara hachina kururama.
y-m-34-02.s.s2.explain: x=1 ne x=-2 kukosha kwakatoshandiswa pakusarudza mafactor mukugadzirisa, saka mativi ose maviri i0, uye leading coefficient i1 kumativi ose maviri.
